title: General Guide to Workplace Traffic Management
abstract:
The General Guide to Workplace Traffic Management (April 2021) provides practical guidance on managing the risks associated with traffic movement in workplaces. It complements the traffic management requirements for public roads but focuses on workplace premises such as warehouses, construction sites, and industrial facilities.

The guide covers separation of pedestrians and vehicles, traffic control measures, speed management, visibility requirements, and the design of traffic management plans for workplace sites. It addresses both powered mobile plant and conventional vehicles operating in work areas.

For Traffic Controllers working on internal traffic management within depot yards, laydown areas, or construction compounds, this guide provides essential principles. It should be read alongside the MRWA Code of Practice for work on public roads, as different requirements may apply to workplace premises versus public roadways.

keyRequirements: PCBUs must manage risks from traffic movement in workplaces
Elimination of traffic hazards is the preferred control measure
Separation of pedestrians and vehicles is essential
Traffic management plans should be documented for workplace sites
